verdict.rationale: First-party headless docs describe a `byteask exec` subcommand for scripting and CI that runs one task to completion and exits. They also document JSON Lines event streaming on stdout for pipelines, JSON Schema-conformant final output for parsing, and `--sandbox workspace-write` and `--ask-for-approval` flags to control what an unattended run may do. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that exec works in real CI, and documentation of non-interactive authentication for CI given the magic-link sign-in default.
